subject: math
description: Identify repeating shape patterns in tiles, textiles, and local designs by deciding whether shapes tessellate without gaps or overlaps.
learningObjectives: Define tessellation using the ideas of repeating patterns, gaps, and overlaps
Identify examples and non-examples of tessellations in tiles, textiles, and local designs
Explain why some shapes tessellate and others do not
Create or complete a simple tessellation pattern on a grid
Use visual evidence to classify geometric patterns
prerequisites: Recognize common polygons such as triangles, squares, rectangles, and hexagons
Notice gaps and overlaps between shapes
Use a ruler or grid paper to draw straight-sided shapes
